controls.title: Change Management Approvals
controls.description: All production changes approved, tested, and documented with backout plans.

controls.title: Segregation of Duties (SOD)
controls.description: No single individual can develop, approve, and deploy changes to financial systems.

controls.title: Production Access Reviews
controls.description: Quarterly review of privileged access to financial systems.

controls.title: Audit Trail Retention
controls.description: Retention of change logs and transaction logs for at least 7 years as applicable.

controls.title: Backup & Restore Tests
controls.description: Periodic backup integrity verification and restore drills for financial systems.

controls.title: Financial Data Classification
controls.description: Classify financial data and apply appropriate controls.
